blocks.html:
Jeep & SUV Lettering and Decals in Toronto

One of the fastest-growing trends is to add lettering and decals to your Jeep or SUV. Whether for personal reasons or for business, branding your vehicles is a fantastic way to get noticed, think of your vehicle as a mobile advertisement.

Now, why would I choose lettering and decals instead of a paint job for my vehicle? Well, we at Vinyl Wrap Toronto are glad you asked! Vinyl lettering and decals are a cost-effective form of customization for your vehicle(s). With the ability to custom design your idea, our team is standing by to help bring your vision to life. Let us help you maximize your vehicle’s space with a well-planned design.

The great versatility of lettering and decals is that you are not limited to only wrapping your vehicle’s painted surfaces, you can have vinyl applied to your windows as well. With a variety of solid and perforated vinyl available, our installers will recommend the best options available for you. Want to learn more about our materials? Check out our What We Use page for more information.

What is perforated vinyl you ask? Perforated vinyl is manufactured with evenly spaced holes spread throughout the film. Graphics are printed on one side of the film and it is then applied to a window. The perforated holes make it so people outside the window can see the colourful advertisement, and those on the inside benefit from reduced sun glare and increased privacy while still being able to see through the glass.

One of the biggest advantages of choosing lettering and decals is the cost. Compared to partial and full wraps lettering and decals give you the bang for your buck that individuals and companies can benefit from. With high impact and lower budgets, you can get your website, phone number, or just your awesome graphics out for the world to notice. When choosing what lettering and decals would work best for your vehicle it is always recommended to speak with one of our professionals. They have the know-how to help you navigate these creative waters.

Passersby or potential clients can lose your business card or forget your name, but they can’t forget your stunning moving billboard.

Give us a call today at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 in the GTA to discuss car signage cost, materials, and other concerns you may have.
